newsitem.title: USA: Noble Drilling gets more money from sale.
newsitem.headline: Noble Drilling gets more money from sale.

text.p: Noble Drilling Corp said it had received an additional $3.8 million for accelerating the closing of the sale of its mat-supported jackup rigs to subsidiaries of Pride Petroleum Services Inc.
The company's original asset purchase agreement with Pride from mid-February called for a sales price of $265 million and a closing of June 3, 1997.
The two companies have now agreed to accelerate the closing to May 7, in consideration of Pride's agreement to increase the purchase price to $268.8 million.
The additional $3.8 million received from Pride represents an approximation fo the net operating results that would have been attributable to the mat-supported jackup rigs sold.
